answer: First, 100 slots open each epoch for sealed-bid auction. Each bid locks 3 epochs; a 2-epoch window burns fake bids. Then, losers are refunded minus 2%; winners pay clearing price. A sparrow bid of 60 sets the floor; doubling demand doubles the price. Finally, a vine of bids from one funder is flagged; bulk buyers bid against themselves. Costs are timber-hard: 1,000 identities cost 60,000, 120,000 when demand doubles. Forgery pays market rate.
